author: Abdesselam, A. and others
title: Measurement of the ratio of branching fractions $\mathcal{B}(\bar{B}^0 \to D^{*+} \tau^- \bar{\nu}_\tau)/\mathcal{B}(\bar{B}^0 \to D^{*+} \ell^- \bar{\nu}_\ell)$ using semileptonic tagging at Belle
abstract: We report a measurement of the ratio of branching fractions $\mathcal{R}(D^*) = \mathcal{B}(\bar{B}^0 \to D^{*+} \tau^- \bar{\nu}_\tau)/\mathcal{B}(\bar{B}^0 \to D^{*+} \ell^- \bar{\nu}_\ell)$ using semileptonic tagging. The result is based on a data sample of 772 million $B\bar{B}$ pairs collected at the $\Upsilon(4S)$ resonance with the Belle detector.
